title: Door County Adventure Rafting

services.name: Private Boat Tour
services.desc: We can get you on the water for a fun and thrilling time. Private tours are a great way to experience the waters around Door County with just your friends and family on the boat. Private tours offer more flexibility and can be booked anytime during the day. Each boat can carry up to 12 passengers (24 total) and custom itineraries are possible. Since every private tour is unique the best way to book one is to give us a call so we can get some specific information about your group and better cater to your needs. Some private boat tour options: Discover the stunning sea caves of Cave Point County Park, see the shipwrecks of Jacksonport and Whitefish Bay, and learn about the Niagara Escarpment
